Row.Text: 组队PVP环形大陆
Team PVP Ring Mainland
环形闭合的2至12人组队战场：陆地呈圆环状，径向厚约16格，人均约300格可用大陆陆地；环内是全部为浅海的内海，分布着岛屿与海洋资源，环外是浅海带与深海并同样分布岛屿与海洋资源。默认东西平分圆环，分界始终为过圆心的南北直径；队内按大厅顺序由北向南分布，队首与队末位于南北接缝前线，中间为后排。海岸文明中，队首出生在最北外海海岸、队末出生在最南外海海岸，其余出生在内海海岸。

A 2-12 player team battlefield shaped as a closed ring. The ring is about 16 tiles thick radially with roughly 300 usable mainland tiles per player. Inside the ring an all-shallow inner sea holds islands and sea resources; outside, a shallow shelf gives way to deep ocean with the same island and sea-resource coverage. Teams default to equal east/west halves split by the north-south diameter; within a team, lobby order runs north to south, so the first and last seats sit on the north/south seam frontline and middle seats stay in the rear. Coastal civilizations take the northern outer shore (first seat), the southern outer shore (last seat) or the inner shore (any other seat).
默认东西分队：两队以过圆心的南北直径平分圆环，队伍人数不同也不移动分界；亦可选南北分队（以东西直径为界）。

Defaults to east-west teams: the north-south diameter through the ring's center always gives equal halves, even when team sizes differ. North-south teams (split by the east-west diameter) are also available.
